Meet Meghna Mukesh

A performer’s journey, with dance taking centre stage.

MEGHNA MUKESH

Studio Director · Desi Nritya Academy

Dance First

Where movement becomes expression

For Meghna Mukesh, this profile puts dance and performance in the spotlight. Dance is presented here as a form of expression, rhythm and connection—with the stage at the heart of the story. The focus is on celebrating movement, creativity and the energy performers bring to an audience.

Alongside her performance journey, public entertainment listings identify Meghna as an Indian actress associated with Tamil cinema. Her listed screen credits include Aaaah (2014), Kasu Iruntha (listed as a 2016 credit) and the horror-thriller Sathura Adi - 3500 (listed as a 2017 title). These credits are included as part of her wider performing-arts background, while dance remains the main emphasis of this page.
